title: WCL Mining Sirdar Mock Test 07
subtitle: Western Coalfields Limited — Mining Sirdar Recruitment
instructions: Select the best answer for each question

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The maximum gradient for a man riding incline system is
options: 1 in 3
1 in 5
1 in 20
1 in 10
questions.solution: The maximum gradient is 1 in 3 for man riding inclines.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The minimum safety factor of a winding rope for persons is
questions.solution: Minimum safety factor is 6 for winding persons.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'volatile matter' in coal includes
options: The ash residue left after the burning
Gases released during heating
The moisture held in the coal seam
The fixed carbon burned away as coke
questions.solution: Volatile matter includes gases released during heating.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: An 'isolation stopping' in case of fire is built to
options: To allow the ventilation of the area
To increase the air supply to the fire
To cool the air around the fire area
Cut off air supply to the fire area
questions.solution: Cuts off air supply to the fire area.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'winze' in mining is a drift driven
options: Upward from the floor of the seam
Horizontally along the coal seam
Vertically downward in the rock only
Downward from an upper level
questions.solution: A winze is a drift driven downward from an upper level.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: As per the Mines Act 1952, women may be employed aboveground only between:
options: 24 hours
6 a.m. and 7 p.m.
5 a.m. and 9 p.m.
8 a.m. and 6 p.m.
questions.solution: Mines Act 1952, s.46: women shall not be employed belowground, and aboveground employment is restricted between 6 a.m. and 7 p.m.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'ventilation of a development face' requires
options: No special arrangement of the ventilation
Forcing or exhausting air directly to the face
The ventilation of the goaf area only
A single fan installed at the surface
questions.solution: Forcing or exhausting air directly to the face.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'sand' as stowing material has advantage of
options: Poor flow through the pipeline
A very low availability of the material
A high cost of the transport to the mine
Good flow properties and availability
questions.solution: Sand has good flow properties and availability.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A first-aid room is required at a mine where the number of persons employed exceeds:
questions.solution: Mines Act 1952, s.21: a first-aid room is required where more than 150 persons are employed.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'mine survey safety' requires
options: The prior approval of the mine manager for the survey of the mine
Proper lighting, communication, and equipment for survey teams
The reduction of the survey equipment maintenance
Work to the pattern of an earlier survey of mine
questions.solution: Survey safety requires lighting, communication, equipment.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Under the Mines Vocational Training Rules 1966, a person before being employed in a mine for the first time must undergo:
options: One month of the refresher training course
A reading of the mine safety rules at all
Initial vocational training in the prescribed subjects
A practical test to be given only on the surface of the mine
questions.solution: MVTR 1966, Rule 6: every person is given initial vocational training before first employment.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The rope used in man riding must be of
options: Steel wire rope as prescribed
Hemp rope of good quality
Nylon rope of any type
Any type of rope available
questions.solution: Steel wire rope as prescribed is required.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The headquarters of DGMS is located at
options: Ranchi
New Delhi
Nagpur
Kolkata
questions.solution: DGMS headquarters is in Ranchi.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A man riding system must be equipped with a device to prevent
options: Excessive speed during normal operation
Rollback in case of power failure or rope breakage
The overloading of the hoisting motor of the system
The dust accumulation on the man riding track
questions.solution: Rollback prevention in case of failure is required.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'first-aid training' for mine rescue team must cover
options: Treatment of injuries, burns, gas poisoning, and mine-specific emergencies
Only the dressing of the minor cuts and the small wounds of the miners there
Only the recovery position of the injured persons in the mine
Only the administration of the medicines to the injured
questions.solution: Injuries, burns, gas poisoning, and mine-specific emergencies.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Who is responsible for ensuring the man riding system is safe?
options: The contractor
The surveyor
The workers
The manager
questions.solution: The manager is responsible for the safety of the system.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'casualty extraction' in mine rescue requires
options: Specialized training in casualty handling and transport
No special training of any kind at all is needed for the work
A general knowledge of the mine roadways plan
No knowledge whatever of the mine gases there
questions.solution: Casualty extraction requires specialized handling training.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'subsidence monitoring' above a stowed area uses
options: The daily walking of the surface
The records of the pumping operations
Surveying instruments and surface markers
The photographs taken by the manager
questions.solution: Surveying instruments and surface markers.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'support yield' in underground mining is intentional because
options: It is regarded as a failure of the roof support at the face
It allows controlled deformation to redistribute stress
It helps to increase the production of the mine
It helps to reduce the cost of the support work
questions.solution: Controlled yield allows stress redistribution.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A scraper conveyor is used to
options: Transport men in the mine
Transport coal along the face
Load coal into railway wagons
Hoist coal up the shaft
questions.solution: Transports coal along the face.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Under CMR 2017, approaching old workings requires
options: A careful examination of the mine plans
Boreholes and risk assessment before approaching
The blasting away of the barrier pillar
The removal of the water dams in the mine
questions.solution: Boreholes and risk assessment before approaching.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Water barriers are used to
options: To improve the ventilation of the mine
To prevent the flow of the return air
To quench the heat of the fire in the mine
Supress coal dust explosions by absorbing heat
questions.solution: Water barriers absorb heat and suppress explosions.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'ventilation survey' is conducted to
options: To provide the fresh air to the working faces of mine
Assess the adequacy and efficiency of the ventilation system
To check the production of the coal mine seams
To control the humidity in the underground workings of the mine area
questions.solution: Assesses adequacy and efficiency of the ventilation system.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A hydraulic prop is used for
options: Permanent support for the main road
Permanent support for the shaft
Providing temporary support at the face
Support for the surface buildings
questions.solution: Provides temporary support at the face.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The winding engine must be maintained by
options: The winding operator working alone
A helper sent from the mine office
The members of the safety committee
Competent maintenance staff under the manager
questions.solution: Competent maintenance staff under the manager.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The sirdar must ensure that the working place is
options: Left as found by the previous sirdar
Properly examined before work begins
Examined only at the mid shift time
Kept fully exempt from the inspection
questions.solution: The working place must be properly examined before work begins.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'blast survey' before shot firing includes
options: The survey of the roof support drill holes
No survey of the mine face is needed at all before firing
Checking drill pattern, hole conditions, and loading
The survey of the stemming operations only
questions.solution: Pre-blast surveys verify patterns, conditions, and loading.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Fly ash from thermal power plants can be used as
options: Only for the building of the roads
Only for the making of the bricks
Only used as a material for roofing
A stowing material in underground coal mines
questions.solution: Can be used as stowing material.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The primary purpose of mine surveying is
options: The reduction of the levels to a common datum
Establish and maintain mine workings in correct position
The preparing of the decorative wall displays
The detection of firedamp in the return airway of the mine workings
questions.solution: Mine surveying establishes and maintains correct positions of workings.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'reduction of levels' in surveying is done to
options: The calculation of the pillar area in the mine working panel
Determine the elevation of points relative to a datum
The measurement of the width of the seam
The selection of the roof bolting pattern
questions.solution: Determine elevation of points relative to a datum.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'explosive usage register' must contain
options: The record of the materials that are used for the roof support
The total explosive used in the whole country
The record of the detonators that are charged
Details of quantity received, used, returned, and destroyed
questions.solution: Details of quantity received, used, returned, destroyed.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Coal dust accumulation of more than
options: The layer of 10 mm thick is fine here
The layer of 5 mm thick is acceptable
The layer of only 1 mm thick coal dust
3 mm thick along the roadway is dangerous
questions.solution: Accumulation of more than 3 mm thick is dangerous.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'support' for drifts depends on
options: Only the depth of the mine shaft
Only the colour of the rock strata
Rock conditions, span, and depth of cover
To prevent the water ingress in mine
questions.solution: Drift support depends on conditions, span, and depth.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'blast timing diagram' shows
options: Used for charging detonators
Used for drilling blast holes
Used for stemming operations
Sequence and timing of all detonators
questions.solution: Timing diagrams show the complete detonation sequence.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'blast crew composition' includes
options: Only the person who owns the explosive
Shot firer, blaster, and safety personnel
Only the mine electrician of the section
Only the contractor who drilled the holes
questions.solution: Blast crews include certified shot firers and safety personnel.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'swing radius' of excavators must be
options: Near to the edge of the bench
Clear of personnel and equipment
Quite unrestricted in the swing
Near to the working persons
questions.solution: Swing radius must be clear of personnel and equipment.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A man riding system using battery-powered vehicles must have
options: Flameproof or intrinsically safe electrical equipment
No any safety features fitted in the system
Equipment certified for surface use only
A manual braking system fitted in each car of the system
questions.solution: Flameproof or intrinsically safe equipment.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'natural ventilation' in a mine depends on
options: The direction of the wind on the surface of the mine workings
The number of the persons working in the mine
The type of the coal that is being mined here
Difference in temperature between intake and return air
questions.solution: Difference in temperature between intake and return air.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'mucking cycle' in drifting includes
options: Drilling of blast holes in the face
Firing of shots in the round
Loading, hauling, and dumping muck
Erection of supports in the drift
questions.solution: Mucking cycle includes load, haul, dump.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The plans and sections of the workings in a mine must be
options: Prepared only after the mine is abandoned
The approval given by the union of the mine workers of the mine
The updating of the plans once in ten years
Prepared, maintained, and kept up-to-date as prescribed
questions.solution: CMR 2017 (Regulations 64 to 68) requires every mine to keep accurate and up-to-date plans and sections of the workings, as prescribed.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'possible reserve' of coal is
options: Fully proved by detailed drilling
Measured by actual excavation
Suggested by limited exploration data
It is fully confirmed by the core
questions.solution: Possible reserves are suggested by limited exploration.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'angle of draw' refers to
options: Angle between vertical and limit of surface subsidence
The angle of the slope of the surface waste dump of the open pit
The angle of the gradient of the haul road
The angle of the slope of the pit benches
questions.solution: Angle of draw defines lateral extent of surface subsidence.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'profile' of a drift is determined by
options: Purpose, equipment size, and geological conditions
The personal taste of the mine manager
The season of the year of the workings
The shape fixed by the mine contractor
questions.solution: Drift profile depends on purpose, equipment, and geology.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: An 'auxiliary fan' in mine ventilation is used to
options: Control humidity in underground workings
To replace the main ventilation fan of the mine
Provide additional ventilation to specific areas
Only to regulate the air temperature of the mine
questions.solution: Provides additional ventilation to specific areas.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The use of water for extinguishing an underground fire must be
options: Controlled to prevent electrical hazards and flooding
It is never permitted in the mine workings
It is used only at the surface workings of the mine area
It is always permitted without any care at all
questions.solution: Controlled to prevent electrical hazards and flooding.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'hazardous area' demarcation requires
options: A verbal instruction to the workers
A chalk mark upon the mine benches
A mention of it in the daily report
Clear boundaries, signage, access control
questions.solution: Hazardous areas need demarcation and access control.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'continuous miner and shuttle car' combination is used in
options: Open cast only
Room and pillar mining
Longwall only
Shaft sinking
questions.solution: Used in room and pillar mining.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The sirdar is responsible for the proper utilization of
options: All materials issued for the work
Explosives issued to the shot-firer alone
Timber used in the roadway alone
The standby pumping capacity alone
questions.solution: All materials issued must be properly utilized.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: 'Competent person' under the Mines Act 1952 means a person:
options: The person who has been appointed by the Inspector of the mines of that region here
The person having 10 years of experience in the mining of the coal seams
Appointed by the owner, agent or manager and possessing the prescribed qualifications
The person holding any degree of engineering in the mining field of mine
questions.solution: Mines Act 1952, s.2(1)(c): a competent person is one appointed by the owner, agent or manager with the prescribed qualifications for the purpose.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A shovel in open cast mining is used for
options: Benching the highwall before drilling
Dredging sludge from the surface sump
Loading overburden and coal into dumpers
Drilling blast holes in the hard rock bench
questions.solution: Loads overburden and coal into dumpers.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'shot firer' must not
options: Fire shots until all persons are withdrawn to a safe distance
Carry out the shot firing without checking the misfire position
Be appointed without a valid blasting certificate
Fire any shot with the stemming left incomplete
questions.solution: Must not fire shots until all persons are safe.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'anchorage testing' of roof bolts is done to
options: The measurement of the bolt diameter
The checking of the colour of the bolt
The increase in the length of the bolt
Verify bolt holding capacity in the roof
questions.solution: Anchorage testing verifies bolt holding capacity in the roof.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The water bar or stopping in a mine is used to
options: The ventilation of the working faces
The supply of water to the fire points
Direct water away from working areas to the sump
To hold back the loose roof of the gallery
questions.solution: Directs water away from working areas to the sump.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The emergency lighting in underground mines must be
options: Provided and operational in case of power failure
Provided only at the surface of the mine
It works at the rated voltage of the mine
Provided only in the mine engine room
questions.solution: Provided and operational in case of power failure.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'magnetic declination' in surveying is the
options: Difference in level between two points
Angle between the plumb line and the vertical
Angle between true north and magnetic north
Angle between the mine rail and the roadway
questions.solution: Angle between true north and magnetic north.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The sirdar's daily report should be submitted to
options: The contractor of the mine
The senior sirdar of the mine
The manager or the under-manager
The elected workers' representatives
questions.solution: The manager or the under-manager.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'drilling accuracy' in drifting is important because
options: It is of no importance for the mine workings
It reduces the cost of the explosives that are used in the mine
It has no effect at all on the drift of mine
It affects the profile, support requirements, and safety
questions.solution: Affects profile, support requirements, and safety.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'ventilation system modification' requires
options: No any approval at all is needed for this ventilation work
The permission of the ventilation fanman
Approval from competent person and documentation
Only the permission of the fanman of mine
questions.solution: Modifications need approval and documentation.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'communication system' at faces must be
options: Only at the main office building of the mine surface
Provided only at the mine lamp room area
Available at all work locations for emergency use
Only at the pit bottom and the mine sump
questions.solution: Communication must be available at all work locations.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'foam extinguishing' system in mines is used for
options: Class A and B fires, especially coal and fuel fires
The fires in the electrical equipment of the mine area
The fires in the mine electrical cables
The fires in the mine winding engine house
questions.solution: Foam systems are effective for coal and fuel fires.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The rope used for winding persons must be
options: A rope of hemp of a very good quality for the winding
A plastic rope of any colour and size
Any rope having a sufficient diameter
A steel wire rope of the prescribed specification
questions.solution: A steel wire rope of prescribed specification is required.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'barrier pillar' between two workings is used to
options: To increase the ventilation pressure of the mine workings
Prevent water from one area inundating the other
To support the buildings of the surface
To improve the haulage of the coal mine
questions.solution: Prevents water from one area inundating the other.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Every mine must have at least one
options: Trained first aider
Nurse
Pharmacist
Doctor
questions.solution: At least one trained first aider is required.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'fixed carbon' in coal is
options: The ash content that is present in the coal of the mine seam
The moisture that is present in the coal of the mine
The volatile matter that is present in the coal seams
The solid carbon remaining after volatile matter is released
questions.solution: Fixed carbon is solid carbon remaining after volatiles.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Coal mine dust containing more than 5% silica is considered
options: Perfectly safe for the workers
Quite harmless to the mine workers
Beneficial to the lungs of the workers
More hazardous as it can cause silicosis
questions.solution: More hazardous as it can cause silicosis.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The accident investigation must be completed within
options: As prescribed by regulations
Within one calendar month
Only after the inquiry is closed
Within a single working day
questions.solution: As prescribed by regulations.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A man riding system using chain haulage must have
options: A loud horn that is fitted on the cars
Safety catches to prevent cars running back
Nothing special is fitted in the system
A single brake that is fitted on the cars
questions.solution: Safety catches to prevent cars running back are required.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'benchmark' in mine surveying is
options: A traverse line of the known bearing
Any point that is fixed on the surface
A point of known elevation used as a reference
A station marked on the surface plan
questions.solution: A point of known elevation used as reference.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The main switch in a mine must have
options: No any special feature fitted in the panel
A decorative cover fitted on the panel
It works at the rated voltage of the mains
A facility for isolation and lockout/tagout
questions.solution: Facility for isolation and lockout/tagout.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'face length' in longwall mining is typically
questions.solution: 150-300 meters.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'shovel-truck match factor' of 1.0 means
options: The trucks of the fleet are waiting
The shovel of the fleet stands idle often
Shovel and truck fleet are perfectly matched
It shows the under-utilization of the fleet
questions.solution: Match factor 1.0 indicates optimal fleet matching.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'blasting' in drifting follows
options: Designed drill pattern for efficient breakage
It is used for drilling the blast holes
No any blasting of the face is needed
A pattern chosen by the drill operator
questions.solution: Drifting blasting follows designed drill patterns.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'total recordable injury frequency rate' (TRIFR) includes
options: Only those accidents which result in the death of the persons working in a mine
Only the lost-time injuries of the persons working in the mine areas
Only the minor first-aid cases of the small injuries of the workers
All recordable injuries including lost time, medical treatment, and restricted work
questions.solution: All recordable injuries including lost time, medical treatment, and restricted work.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Electronic detonators offer advantage over pyrotechnic by providing
options: Lower cost
No initiation energy
Higher explosive power
Precise timing accuracy
questions.solution: Electronic detonators provide millisecond-accurate timing.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A shot-firer who has not been employed in blasting duties for more than 6 months shall undergo:
options: A fresh and initial training of the period of one month
Retraining in the handling of explosives before resuming such duties
A refresher course in the first aid of the mine rescue team members here
A written test of the mine safety rules of the mine
questions.solution: MVTR 1966, Rule 13: retraining in handling of explosives is required after an absence from such duties exceeding 6 months.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A person re-employed after an absence exceeding one year from mining work must undergo refresher training within:
options: 1 week
6 months
1 month of employment
3 months of employment
questions.solution: MVTR 1966, Rule 10: refresher training within 1 month of re-employment after absence over 1 year.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'air quantity' required per person in a mine is typically
options: 20 m³/min
1 m³/min
100 m³/min
3-6 m³/min
questions.solution: Typically 3-6 m³/min per person.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: As per MVTR 1966, refresher vocational training must be given to persons employed in mines at least once in:
options: 5 years
2 years
1 year
10 years
questions.solution: MVTR 1966, Rule 8: refresher training at least once in every 5 years.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'borehole monitoring' in inundation prevention involves
options: The reading of the water pressure gauges fitted in the mine area
The records of the pumping hours of the mine workings
The rainfall records of the coal mining season of mine
Checking for water inflow and pressure through drilled boreholes
questions.solution: Checking for water inflow and pressure through drilled boreholes.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Suitable protective equipment and clothing required for safety must be provided to the workers
options: At no cost to the worker
At half the cost to the worker
Only to the senior workers
Only on a written request
questions.solution: The owner, agent and manager are required to provide and maintain suitable protective equipment and clothing, as necessary, at no cost to the worker.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'coal gasification' can produce
options: The refined diesel fuel for the long haul freight movement
Coke for iron making in a blast furnace
Liquefied petroleum gas for domestic cooking
Syngas for power, chemicals, and transportation fuel
questions.solution: Syngas for power, chemicals, and fuel.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'depillaring' in underground mining involves
options: Raising a stall from the parent roadway
Filling the goaf with pumped slurry waste
Driving a cross-cut between two roadways
Extraction of pillars left during development
questions.solution: Extraction of pillars left during development.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'coal grading' system in India classifies coal based on
options: The seam thickness at each exploration borehole
The overburden to coal ratio in the open cast pit
The ash content measured at the washery
Gradation based on Useful Heat Value (UHV)
questions.solution: Gradation based on Useful Heat Value.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'energy mix' of India includes approximately what percentage from coal?
questions.solution: Approximately 70% from coal.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'District Mineral Foundation' (DMF) was established under
options: CMR 2017
DGMS Circulars
Mines Act
MMDR Act 2015
questions.solution: Established under MMDR Act 2015.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The diagonal of a square with side 10 cm is
options: 10 cm
20 cm
100 cm
questions.solution: Diagonal = 10√2 ≈ 14.14 cm.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: Man walks 3km N, 4km E. Distance from start?
options: 12 km
5 km
7 km
1 km

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The Korba coalfield is located in
options: Odisha
Jharkhand
Chhattisgarh
Madhya Pradesh
questions.solution: Korba coalfield is in Chhattisgarh.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'CIL's production efficiency' depends on
options: The number of the workers that are employed in the coal mines
The depth of the coal seams that are being mined
Equipment utilization, manpower deployment, and clearances
Nothing specific at all to the coal mining sector
questions.solution: Equipment utilization, manpower, and clearances.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'renewable energy' adoption by CIL includes
options: The use of the diesel generators
The power purchased from the grid
Solar and wind power projects at mine sites
Nothing specific to the mine sector
questions.solution: Solar and wind power projects.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The deepest ocean trench is
options: Java Trench
Philippine Trench
Mariana Trench
Tonga Trench
questions.solution: Mariana Trench is the deepest ocean trench.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: A line graph shows rainfall: 50mm, 80mm, 120mm, 100mm, 60mm over 5 months. What is the total rainfall?
options: 450mm
360mm
400mm
410mm

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: Pick odd: Circle, Triangle, Square, Rectangle
options: Circle
Rectangle
Square
Triangle
questions.solution: Circle has no sides; others are polygons.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: In a family, father is 4 times son's age. In 20 years, father will be twice son's age. Son's present age?
options: 15 years
20 years
5 years
10 years

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'mine lease' period in India is typically
options: 50 years
10 years
20 years
30 years
questions.solution: Typically 30 years.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: Which gas is commonly called 'laughing gas'?
options: Methane
Nitrous oxide
Sulphur dioxide
Carbon dioxide
questions.solution: Nitrous oxide is commonly called laughing gas.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'Coal India Scientific Research Foundation' (CISRF) promotes
options: Fixation of the royalty on coal
Railway freight rates for coal dispatch
Technical training for underground mine workers
Research and development in coal sector
questions.solution: Promotes R&D in coal sector.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The 'Talcher Thermal Power Station' is located in
options: Odisha
Jharkhand
Chhattisgarh
Maharashtra
questions.solution: Located in Odisha.

questions.subject: General
questions.stem: The area of a rectangle with length 12 cm and breadth 8 cm is
options: 120 cm²
100 cm²
80 cm²
